description: We are a team of 6 enthusiastic students interested in technology, robotics, Artificial Intelligence, & automation. We enjoy learning new technologies, developing innovative ideas, and solving real-world problems. Our team believes in teamwork, creativity, communication, & continuous learning. We are looking for passionate and dedicated members with skills in programming, electronics, designing, problem-solving, & innovative thinking who are interested in working together and sharing knowledge.
summary:
Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer is an interactive, game-based educational platform designed to introduce children aged 8–14 to space science and astronaut activities in a fun and engaging way. We developed an educational website that allows children to explore the solar system, learn about planets, understand life in space, and experience astronaut missions through interactive activities.

Our platform includes animated characters, voice instructions, space exploration missions, quizzes, educational games, and mission challenges. It uses a child-friendly interface with colourful visuals to make learning simple, enjoyable, and interactive.

The project addresses the challenge of making space education more accessible and interesting for young learners. Instead of depending only on traditional textbooks, children can learn by exploring, participating in missions, solving challenges, and testing their knowledge.

This project is important because it encourages curiosity about space, develops problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, and inspires the next generation to explore science, technology, engineering, and space exploration.
details:
We used ChatGPT as an AI-assisted tool during the development of our Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer project.

AI assistance was used for brainstorming project ideas, generating and improving website code, suggesting interactive features, organizing educational content, explaining technical concepts, and identifying possible improvements.

We used AI-generated suggestions to develop the website structure, animations, interactive learning activities, quizzes, and mission challenges. We reviewed, modified, and tested the generated code to suit our project requirements.

AI was used as a supporting tool, while our team made the project decisions, implemented the features, integrated the components, and worked on testing and improving the website.

We acknowledge the use of AI tools and take responsibility for the final project, its content, functionality, and presentation.
